technical.summary: ABT shows oversold bounce signals (RSI, Stoch) with longer-term bullish structure, but price remains below all key moving averages with weak volume confirmation and negative CMF, limiting swing entry conviction.

fundamental.summary: ABT shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 55 days present material risk with insufficient fundamental support.

sentiment.summary: No actionable congressional signal; mixed market sentiment (bearish bias 39.7% vs bullish 27.4%) with greed reading provides neutral backdrop; insufficient data for conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (142.6) indicates extreme market stress, strong dollar pressures multinational healthcare revenues, and earnings in 55 days adds event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: RSI/Stoch oversold with bullish crossover and longer-term EMA structure (20/50/50/200 bullish) suggest technical bounce potential from support at 95.24.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price trapped below all major moving averages with negative CMF, weak volume, zero fundamental conviction, earnings event risk in 55 days, and macro crisis conditions (VIX 142.6, inverted yield curve, strong dollar) create asymmetric downside risk.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical oversold bounce (RSI 9, Stoch) with bullish EMA structure offers tactical entry, but conviction severely undermined by price trapped below all moving averages, negative CMF, and zero fundamental support.
decision.primary_risk: Macro crisis conditions (VIX 142.6, inverted yield curve, strong dollar) combined with earnings event risk in 55 days create asymmetric downside; existing ABT position and 5 open Healthcare positions amplify sector concentration risk.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
decision.portfolio_note: Existing ABT position + 5 open Healthcare positions create material sector concentration; portfolio already at 32 open positions limits capacity for marginal conviction trades.
